title: Mickee Faust Clubhouse

explain.meaning: Standard entry, without reserved seats or extras.

gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: The Mickee Faust Club is a community theater for the weird community. The Mickee Faust Club is not a theater that waits around for permission or even funding. For nearly four decades, we have made space-sometimes literally out of nothing-for artists who are too queer, too disabled, too poor, too loud, too political, or too weird for traditional stages.
